concept.title: One Jar, Ten Seconds
concept.hook: Alarm clock buzzes on a nightstand, cut straight to the jar on a bathroom shelf. On-screen line: One jar. Ten seconds. Out the door.
concept.surpriseBeat: The clock-like cuts speed up into a countdown rhythm, and the whole routine lands at exactly ten seconds on the overlay timer, ending with the person already out the door.

locations.description: Bright small apartment bathroom with a plain shelf and a mirror
locations.lighting: soft natural window light, warm neutral grade, creamy highlights

locations.description: Small entryway with keys on a hook and a bag by the door
locations.lighting: soft daylight from a nearby window, slightly lifted shadows

scenes.action: A bedside alarm clock buzzes, then a hard cut to the jar sitting on a plain bathroom shelf, lid with debossed circle facing up.
scenes.framing: Medium shot of the jar centered on the shelf, mirror softly blurred behind
scenes.motion: The jar is still. A hand enters late and lifts the jar by its sides.
scenes.overlayText: One jar. Ten seconds. Out the door.
scenes.sound: Alarm buzz, then a soft finger-snap beat starts at about 100 bpm

scenes.action: A person in their early thirties, in an oatmeal knit sweater with hair in a plain claw clip, twists the lid off at the mirror and scoops a pea-sized amount of glossy gel-cream with two fingers.
scenes.framing: Eye-level 35mm-feel shot at the mirror, jar held low in frame with label kept clear of fingers
scenes.motion: Relaxed, unhurried movements: twist, scoop, lift to the face
scenes.lighting: soft window light from the side
scenes.dialogue: One step. Light gel-cream, sinks in fast.
scenes.sound: Soft lid twist, warm electric piano enters

scenes.action: The person presses the gel-cream across cheeks and forehead. A tight macro shot of the gel on the fingertips melting into skin.
scenes.framing: Tight macro on fingertips and cheek, then a quick medium of the face
scenes.motion: Gentle pressing with two fingers, the gel visibly sinking in
scenes.lighting: soft window light, fine film grain
scenes.overlayText: Unscented. No sunscreen. Fits a simple routine.
scenes.sound: Quiet, close room tone with a gentle bass pulse

scenes.action: Quick 1 second cuts: tinted balm swiped across the cheek, the jar set down on the shelf, keys grabbed off the hook, a simple blazer thrown on.
scenes.framing: Fast medium shots linked by whip pans, following a clock-like rhythm
scenes.motion: Brisk, easy movement from bathroom to entryway
scenes.lighting: soft natural window light, warm neutral grade
scenes.overlayText: Works under makeup or on its own.
scenes.sound: Finger-snap beat tightens, keys jingle, door handle click

scenes.action: The door closes behind the person. Hold on the jar on the plain bathroom shelf, the lid with its debossed circle clearly visible.
scenes.framing: Still, centered medium shot of the jar on the shelf, lid and label readable
scenes.motion: The jar is still. The camera pushes in very slowly.
scenes.dialogue: Simple on purpose. Shop when you're ready.
scenes.sound: Small musical lift from synth pads, then settling

rubric.reason: Closely follows the brief's clock-like rhythm and gives the jar a real used role. The surprise (speeding countdown ending out the door) is clear but fairly mild.

concept.title: Morning Skincare, Minus the Whole Shelf
concept.hook: A shelf crowded with a dozen blank, unlabeled bottles, then a hand sweeps them all out of frame, leaving only the jar. On-screen line: Morning skincare, minus the whole shelf.
concept.surpriseBeat: A single arm sweep clears the entire crowded shelf in the first seconds, leaving only the jar and making the one-step idea visual.

locations.description: Tidy bedroom vanity by a window with a small mirror
locations.lighting: soft natural window light, warm neutral grade, lifted shadows

locations.description: Bright small apartment bathroom with a plain shelf

scenes.action: A vanity shelf crowded with plain, unmarked bottles and tubes. A forearm in an oatmeal knit sweater sweeps across and clears them all out of frame, leaving the jar alone.
scenes.framing: Locked medium shot of the full shelf, jar ends centered
scenes.motion: One quick sweep of the arm, then stillness
scenes.lighting: soft window light from the left
scenes.overlayText: Morning skincare, minus the whole shelf.
scenes.sound: Soft clatter, then a finger-snap beat drops in

scenes.action: The person, early thirties, hair in a claw clip, twists off the lid and scoops a pea-sized amount of gel-cream with two fingers, then presses it across cheeks and forehead.
scenes.framing: Eye-level 35mm-feel at the vanity mirror, jar held low, label clear of fingers
scenes.motion: Easy scoop and press, relaxed shoulders
scenes.lighting: soft window light, fine film grain
scenes.dialogue: One jar. Light gel-cream, and it sinks in fast.
scenes.sound: Lid twist, warm electric piano, gentle bass pulse

scenes.action: Macro shot of the glossy gel melting into skin on the cheek, then a quick cut of tinted balm going on smoothly over it.
scenes.framing: Tight macro on fingertips and cheek, then a close shot of the face
scenes.motion: Slow pressing motion, then a light swipe of balm
scenes.overlayText: Works under makeup or on its own.
scenes.sound: Quiet close sound, airy synth pad swells

scenes.action: Jar set down on the plain bathroom shelf. The person, in a blazer, walks past and out the door. Final hold on the jar with its debossed circle lid.
scenes.framing: Starts close on the jar, pulls back slightly to the empty shelf, then holds still on the jar
scenes.motion: Jar set down once and left still
scenes.overlayText: Unscented. No sunscreen. Shop the daily gel-cream.
scenes.dialogue: Keep it simple. Shop when you're ready.
scenes.sound: Door closes, small lift in the music, then calm finish

rubric.reason: The shelf sweep is a strong visual hook that dramatizes the one-step idea using a brief hook line. The product role is good, though the pour of routine steps is standard.

concept.title: Same Jar, Two Clocks
concept.hook: Alarm clock reads morning, a hand grabs the jar. On-screen line: Your routine does not need ten steps.
concept.surpriseBeat: A quick cut reveals a second adult in their late thirties doing the same routine at night in a soft gray robe, showing the jar fits any busy schedule.

locations.description: Bright small apartment bathroom with a mirror and plain shelf
locations.lighting: soft window light by day, warm lamp light at night

locations.description: Small entryway with keys and a bag by the door

scenes.action: Alarm clock buzzes. Cut to a hand in a white tee sleeve lifting the jar from a plain shelf.
scenes.framing: Close eye-level shot on the jar and hand entering late, label clear
scenes.motion: A quick lift of the jar
scenes.overlayText: Your routine does not need ten steps.

scenes.action: The early thirties person in a white tee twists off the lid, scoops a pea-sized amount with two fingers, and presses it on cheeks and forehead.
scenes.framing: Eye-level mirror shot, jar low in frame, fingers away from label
scenes.lighting: soft window light, fine film grain
scenes.dialogue: One step. A light gel-cream that sinks in fast.

scenes.action: Macro of gel melting into skin, then tinted balm smooth over it, then keys grabbed off the hook in the entryway.
scenes.framing: Macro on fingertips, then quick medium cuts at about 1 second each
scenes.overlayText: Works under makeup or on its own.

scenes.action: Quick cut: a second adult in their late thirties, in a soft gray robe, scoops the same gel-cream at the bathroom mirror at night.
scenes.framing: Locked medium shot at the mirror, warm lamp glow, jar label visible and clear of hands

scenes.action: Hold on the jar on the plain bathroom shelf, lid with debossed circle visible, the room empty.
scenes.framing: Still centered shot of the jar on the shelf
scenes.motion: The jar is still, the camera pushes in very slowly
scenes.overlayText: Unscented. No sunscreen. Shop the daily gel-cream.
scenes.dialogue: Simple on purpose. Shop when you're ready.

rubric.reason: Uses both talents from the brief and shows the jar used clearly. The night cut is a gentle surprise and the hook is quieter than the shelf sweep.
